text:
erin: Opening a tiny PR to add CLI + terraform examples for reserved pool provisioning, plus a short note on eviction edge-cases and label parsing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3147

felix: Nice. Can you show a case where labels contain commas or special chars? Those have bitten users when selector parsing was naive.

erin: Good catch. Added a note and an example showing quoted labels. CLI snippet below.

erin: ```bash
# create reserved pool with labels (comma in a label value is quoted)
rctl capacity create \--name reserved-eu-2 \--gpus 4 \--labels "pool=reserved-eu-2,owner=team-\"search,rank\""
```

carla: Oof. We should encourage using label keys for routing and avoid commas in values, but it's useful to show how to escape. Also include a YAML reserved pool example and a small note that `grace_period_seconds` only applies to soft eviction.

erin: Added YAML and the footnote. YAML:```yaml
reserved_pool:
  name: reserved-eu-2
  gpus: 4
  labels:
    pool: reserved-eu-2
    owner: "team-search,rank"
  eviction_policy: soft
  grace_period_seconds: 300
```

maya: Can we also add a Terraform snippet for infra folks? They often search the handbook for TF examples. Small snippet is fine.

erin: Added terraform resource with label map and a comment about how the selector matches labels.

paul: Tiny nit: clarify that `eviction_policy: hard` ignores grace periods and will preempt immediately. Also say what metrics trigger eviction in soft mode (idle_kill vs mem_pressure).

carla: Suggest adding a one-liner about KMS/HSM keys not being moved during eviction for compliance customers.

erin: Added both notes. Ran the docs linkchecker locally and saw one bad crosslink: `/dedicated/eviction` -> should be `/dedicated/eviction-policy`. Updated links in the PR.

docs-bot: Linkcheck: 1 broken link detected and auto-fixed: `/dedicated/eviction` -> `/dedicated/eviction-policy`. Patch applied.

felix: Approving content. Small grammar nit: replace "will be preempted" with "may be preempted" in the soft eviction paragraph.

erin: Updated wording. Pinging @carla @maya for final review.

carla: Approved. :white_check_mark:

maya: Approved from infra docs side. :+1:

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck passed, build OK, staged deploy OK.

erin: Merged. Summary: added CLI, YAML, and Terraform snippets, clarified label escaping, documented soft vs hard eviction behavior and grace period applicability, fixed crosslink. Will backport a trimmed advisory to the 1.x handbook pages. Thanks! :tada:
